description: This file defines the class 'DefaultDataPopulator' responsible for populating default data into the vtiger CRM database during installation, including creating tables, inserting module-specific fields, blocks, and relationships.

classes.name: DefaultDataPopulator
classes.description: A class extending CRMEntity, tasked with populating default schema and data during CRM installation.

methods.name: DefaultDataPopulator
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger and database instance.

methods.name: create_tables
methods.description: Populates default module data by inserting records into 'vtiger_tab', 'vtiger_blocks', 'vtiger_field', and other related tables to set up module structure and default fields.

methods.name: create_tables
methods.description: Populates database with fields for various modules, setting up module schemas and default data.

methods.name: initWebservices
methods.description: Sets up webservice entity and operation information by invoking helper methods.

methods.name: vtws_addOperationInfo
methods.description: Defines webservice operations including login, retrieve, create, update, delete, and more, specifying include files, handlers, parameters, and request types.

methods.name: vtws_addEntityInfo
methods.description: Registers modules and special entities with webservice, including default actors and entity tables.

methods.name: vtws_addFieldInfo
methods.description: Adds specific field info for organization details.

methods.name: vtws_addFieldTypeInformation
methods.description: Defines field types for webservice, such as picklist, text, autogen, URL, etc., and sets reference type information.

methods.name: vtws_addReferenceTypeInformation
methods.description: Maps uitypes to reference module types and sets up entity-specific field reference types.

methods.name: addInventoryRows
methods.description: Configures inventory module sequence numbers based on provided parameters.

methods.name: addEntriesForSettings
methods.description: Populates the database with default setting blocks, fields, icons, links, and configuration entries for the CRM settings interface.

methods.name: addDefaultLeadMapping
methods.description: Sets up default field mappings for lead conversion, linking lead fields to account, contact, and potential fields.
